name: 組み立てたサラダの材料と追加希望を確認する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE Japanese Lighthouse salad ingredient/extra review component LH19-0011, compact complete portrait with pure white canvas.
HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL sweetgreen current state has highest priority for pencil icon geometry, circular plus/minus strokes/proportions, toggle check/knob anatomy, disabled state, alignment/spacing and fine detail. Image2 ORIGINAL earlier state and image4 exact ORIGINAL hero crop establish protected food artwork. Image3 Japanese native mock is SECONDARY translated content/layout, never authority for rough icons/omissions. Image5 approved Lighthouse style only: white rounded surfaces, fine boundaries, soft elevation, forest green primary actions.
Keep exact hero arrangement from image4: two kale pieces at left, halved red tomato top-right, cherry tomato center, avocado half bottom-right, original shadow and colors. Preserve original photo crop/geometry; no added salad bowl or food.
Below hero: heading 「ヘルシーグリーンズ」 and accurate source outline pencil edit icon at trailing right; 「550 kcal」 (CURRENT state image1, do not replace with earlier240). A row of3 quiet white rounded ingredient cards: 「ルッコラ」 with original arugula photo; 「ベビー」 line1 「ほうれん草」 line2 with3-leaf spinach photo; 「バルサミコ」 line1 「ビネグレット」 line2 with brown dressing bowl. Artwork is visible in originals and was individually inspected; preserve composition/colors, beige only within source photo crops.
Then section 「ドレッシングと詳細」, fine neutral line. Row1 label 「バルサミコビネグレット」, circular minus, 「2ポーション」, circular plus. Row2 「パンを追加（100 kcal）」, ON toggle with green track, white knob on RIGHT and source white CHECK on left track (restore source check absent from rough mock). Row3 「数量」, disabled pale gray minus, 「1」, available slate-outline plus. Keep all exact states, no generated nutrition calculation.
Bottom2 actions: quiet outlined 「調整する」 and primary 「バッグに追加」 with forest gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, legible white label and restrained depth. Supporting outline icons #526173, white surfaces, neutral borders/dividers, ink #1D1D1D and secondary #6E6E6E. No random accents, broad mint, prices, invented ingredient, new controls or extra navigation.
Locked typography Meiryo heading Bold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0 at logical phone scale; preserve mock role-specific wrapping. Keep compact readable all content without clipping, one balanced white surface, no deeply nested decorative cards, no excessive gloss.
reviewNotes: 原本2状態・全派生写真・日本語モックを実見。550kcal・3材料・2ポーション・パンONのチェックと右つまみ・数量1と無効minus・操作2点・日本語を確認。原本優先で細部を復元。森林色はバッグ追加とON。原画像から葉の境界・ドレッシングの器に再描画差があるため要修正で保持。所有者承認・編集可能性・カロリー連動・動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
